name: bv-bahia-archers-league
description: Sistema de organización y gestión de torneos de la Liga Bahiense de Arquería

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @bal/shared build && concurrently -n shared,api,app,landing -c gray,blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @bal/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/api dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/app dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/landing dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bal/shared build && pnpm --filter @bal/api build && pnpm --filter @bal/app build && pnpm --filter @bal/landing build
